# Hevo Data

> Hevo Data is a no-code ETL and data integration platform with 150+ connectors for automated, reliable data pipelines to cloud data warehouses.

Hevo provides an end-to-end data integration platform combining data ingestion, transformation, warehouse loading, and pipeline observability. The platform serves enterprises across industries with features like change data capture (CDC), real-time monitoring, auto-healing reliability, and comprehensive governance controls.

## Key Topics

- ETL
- Data Integration
- Data Pipeline
- Data Ingestion
- Change Data Capture (CDC)
- Data Warehouse
- No-Code Platform
- Data Transformation
- Observability & Monitoring
- Data Governance
- Reliability Engine
- Database Replication
- SaaS Integration
- dbt Integration
- Real-Time Data

## Core Platform

- [Hevo Data | ETL, Data Integration & Data Pipeline Platform](https://hevodata.com): Hevo's automated unified data platform for ETL with 150+ connectors
- [Hevo Data | Reliable No-Code Data Integration Platform](https://hevodata.com/pipeline): No-code data pipeline platform with CDC and real-time integration
- [Data Ingestion Software for Scalable, No-Code Data Integration](https://hevodata.com/product/ingestion): Data ingestion software with 150+ connectors for SaaS and databases
- [Data Transformation Software to Build Analytics-Ready Models](https://hevodata.com/product/transformations): Data transformation with dbt integration for analytics-ready models
- [Load Data into Cloud Data Warehouses with Reliable, Scalable ETL](https://hevodata.com/product/warehouse): ETL for Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift with automated schema handling

## Data Pipeline Features

- [Reliable ETL Software for Auto-Healing, Fault-Tolerant Pipelines](https://hevodata.com/product/reliability-engine): Auto-healing ETL with intelligent retries and enterprise-grade SLAs
- [Data Pipeline Observability for Real-Time Monitoring & Alerts](https://hevodata.com/product/observability-alerts): Real-time pipeline monitoring with smart alerts and anomaly detection
- [Data Pipeline Governance with Usage Controls & Audit Logging | Hevo](https://hevodata.com/governance): Pipeline governance with audit logging, usage controls, and SAML SSO
- [Easy-to-Use ETL Software for Fast, Reliable Data Integration](https://hevodata.com/product/ease-of-use): User-friendly ETL with automatic schema handling and zero maintenance

## Data Integration Use Cases

- [High Volume Database Replication | Hevo Data](https://hevodata.com/pipeline/database-replication): Log-based CDC for PostgreSQL, Oracle to Snowflake, BigQuery replication
- [Automate SaaS Data Integration in Minutes | Hevo Data](https://hevodata.com/pipeline/saas-replication): No-code SaaS integration to BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift for 2000+ users
- [Effortless File Ingestion to Your Data Warehouse | Hevo Data](https://hevodata.com/pipeline/file-storage-replication): File ingestion from S3, Google Sheets, FTP supporting CSV, JSON, XLSX
- [Hevo: Automated Data Pipelines for Tech & Product Innovation](https://hevodata.com/software-and-technology): ELT platform for tech companies enabling product analytics and GTM insights

## Enterprise & Security

- [Security | Hevo Data](https://hevodata.com/security): Enterprise security with TLS 1.2, AES encryption, and compliance
- [ETL Tool with 24/7 Human Support & Customer-First Assistance](https://hevodata.com/product/enterprise-support): 24/7 human support with dedicated TAMs and guided onboarding
